endorsements.name: Shawn Henry
endorsements.label: Changing the Security Paradigm: Taking Back Your Network and Bringing Pain to the Adversary
endorsements.description: The threat to our networks is increasing at an unprecedented rate. The hostile environment we operate in has rendered traditional security strategies obsolete. Adversary advances require changes in the way we operate, and "offense" changes the game.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 20
